summary: Iteration 292 — Drivers License + Storage Test + Vehicle License Check: All features tested and working correctly. Backend: 24/25 tests passed (1 test failed due to rate limiting on user registration, not a bug). Frontend: All UI components verified and functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Storage Test Endpoint: POST /api/admin/storage/test correctly performs round-trip test (upload + download + verify), returns ok:true with bytes count (58 bytes)
Storage Health Endpoint: GET /api/admin/storage/health returns {available: true, source: 'env'} when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set
Drivers License CRUD: All self-service endpoints working (POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/users/me/drivers-licenses)
Drivers License Validation: Standard class validation works (rejects unknown classes), custom class requires non-empty custom_label
Photo Upload: POST /api/users/me/drivers-licenses/{lic_id}/photo correctly validates MIME type (rejects non-image), stores in Object Storage
Photo Download: GET /api/users/me/drivers-licenses/{lic_id}/photo/{side} returns image with correct content-type
Admin Access: GET /api/users/{user_id}/drivers-licenses correctly enforces admin OR users.view_drivers_license capability
Admin List: GET /api/admin/drivers-licenses returns cross-user table with filters (license_class, expiring_within_days)
CSV Export: GET /api/admin/drivers-licenses/export.csv returns UTF-8 BOM CSV with semicolon delimiter and German headers
Vehicle License Check: POST /api/resource-bookings correctly returns 403 with code='license_missing' when driver lacks required class
Capability: users.view_drivers_license correctly defined in CAPABILITIES list

success_rate.backend: 96% (24/25 tests passed, 1 failed due to rate limiting)
